verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is an API-first server with no required UI. It ships as a single dependency-free binary that installs via a scriptable cURL one-liner, and it has official Docker images, Helm charts and typed SDKs, so it runs headlessly and can be automated. Community reports confirm easy Docker and k8s deployments that 'just worked'. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or ephemeral test-instance guidance), documented non-interactive configuration and automation workflows.
